# libc_startup.steptrace.txt - the address of every instruction the REAL CPU executes, in order.
# A measurement: never hand-edit it. regenerate.sh re-creates it with nativetrace.c and diffs it against this file.
# Produced by nativetrace.c (ptrace single-step) with --custom on the committed libc_startup binary: nativetrace maps the program
# itself and starts it on the reference process stack described in libc_startup.initial_stack.txt (argv=["/bin/prog"], 2 env strings, 15 auxv entries).
# 690 raw single-steps; consecutive identical addresses (iterations of one `rep` instruction) are folded, leaving 653 instruction executions.
# One lowercase hex address per line, no 0x prefix. The engine, started on an initial stack with the same argc/argv0/env/auxv entries,
# must execute exactly this sequence (counting each `rep` instruction once).
